legend: In the eccentric town of GCDland, there lives a mathematician named Theo, who has a wild and paranoid conspiracy theory. Theo is convinced that in certain mystical arrays, the greatest common divisor (GCD) of every possible pair of numbers is always the same. He believes that these arrays are messages from an ancient civilization trying to communicate with us through numbers.

Theo's friends think he's gone off the deep end, but he's determined to prove them wrong and uncover the truth behind these arrays. He needs your help to validate his theory. Given an array of integers, your task is to determine whether the GCD of every pair of numbers in the array is indeed the same. If Theo's theory holds true for the given array, you should confirm it; otherwise, you should debunk it.
The GCD of two numbers is the largest positive integer that divides both numbers without leaving a remainder.
input: The first line contains an integer N$$$N$$$ (2≤N≤100,000$$$2 \leq N \leq 100,000$$$), the number of elements in the array.
The second line contains N$$$N$$$ integers Ai$$$A_i$$$ (1≤Ai≤107$$$1 \leq A_i \leq 10^7$$$), the elements of the array.
output: Print "YES" if the GCD of every pair of numbers in the array is the same. Otherwise, print "NO".

legend.ai: 在古怪的 GCDland 小镇上，住着一位名叫 Theo 的数学家，他有一个疯狂而多疑的阴谋论。Theo 坚信，在某些神秘数组中，任意一对数字的最大公约数（GCD）总是相同的。他认为这些数组是古代文明试图通过数字与我们交流的信息。
Theo 的朋友们觉得他已经彻底疯了，但他决心证明他们错了，并揭开这些数组背后的真相。他需要你的帮助来验证他的理论。给定一个整数数组，你的任务是判断数组中任意一对数字的最大公约数是否确实相同。如果 Theo 的理论对给定数组成立，你应该确认这一点；否则，你应该推翻它。
两个数字的最大公约数是能够整除这两个数字且不留下余数的最大正整数。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 N$$$N$$$(2≤N≤100,000$$$2 \leq N \leq 100,000$$$)，表示数组中的元素个数。
第二行包含 N$$$N$$$ 个整数 Ai$$$A_i$$$(1≤Ai≤107$$$1 \leq A_i \leq 10^7$$$)，表示数组中的元素。

output.ai: 如果数组中每一对数的最大公约数都相同，则输出“YES”；否则输出“NO”。
